scotch_source.relevant_behavior: A nonempty processorWeights list takes precedence. Otherwise, domains plus domainWeights select SCOTCH_archTleaf. The implementation scales by the minimum domain weight: (1, 0.01) therefore becomes (100, 1). This describes the pinned OpenFOAM wrapper, not a measured runtime hardware cost.

hardware_and_rank_map.observed: Two packages x 28 physical cores; 56 Open MPI ranks bind 28 to package 0 and 28 to package 1.
hardware_and_rank_map.interpretation_limit: The observed package mapping justifies logical rank//28 grouping. Processor-boundary faces are not measured bytes, latency, bandwidth, page placement, or solver speed.
